 On the show Need Thanksgiving Advice? Martha Stewart and Giada De Laurentiis Are Answering Questions on TODAY
 Ready to talk turkey? Send us your burning questions. Oct. 22, 2026, 9:50 AM EDT TODAY
 Martha Stewart, the queen of Thanksgiving, and Giada De Laurentiis will be on the show Nov. 12 to answer your burning Thanksgiving questions.  Getty Images Share Add TODAY to Google Hosting Thanksgiving can be overwhelming, but a little expert advice can make all the difference! From planning your menu and setting the table to prepping ahead and keeping guests happy, tell us what you’d like help with this holiday season. On Nov. 12, Martha Stewart and Giada De Laurentiis are joining TODAY to share their best tips and answer viewers’ submissions for a delicious and stress-free Thanksgiving!
